claims.text: Ridgemont Holdings wants support to redesign its operating model across five business units to speed up decision‑making.
The work includes diagnosing decision bottlenecks and management layering, redesigning the operating model and governance, and providing transition support after go‑live.
VCG will apply its four‑phase delivery methodology – Diagnose, Design, Deliver, Sustain – to structure the engagement.
A joint steering committee will be convened and will meet fortnightly to oversee progress.
For engagements longer than six months, a dedicated Engagement Quality Director independent of the delivery team will be assigned.
Knowledge‑transfer workshops will be run in the final four weeks to ensure a smooth transition after go‑live.
VCG redesigned Larkfield Group’s operating model across five business units, removed three management layers and cut decision‑cycle time by 31 percent.
The Larkfield engagement was delivered in six months and included a 90‑day transition‑support period.
VCG’s Global Operations Review for Halden Group covered nine operating units and achieved a 12 percent reduction in indirect operating cost over ten months.
VCG can mobilise local delivery teams within ten business days of contract signature, leveraging presence in 14 markets.
VCG employs 2,000 consultants across six practices and has delivered 340 engagements since 2020, with a client repeat‑engagement rate of 68 percent.
VCG has demonstrated the ability to redesign operating models across multiple business units and deliver measurable speed‑to‑decision improvements.
The firm can mobilise delivery resources quickly, typically within ten business days, ensuring rapid project start‑up.
A dedicated Engagement Quality Director and fortnightly steering committee provide rigorous governance and quality assurance throughout the project.
VCG’s high repeat‑engagement rate (68 percent) reflects strong client satisfaction and long‑term partnership capability.
The combination of proven operating‑model outcomes, rapid mobilisation, and structured governance positions VCG to meet Ridgemont’s objectives efficiently.
